title: Rubber duck
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE45C'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#FFC40D'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E8A200'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='headGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF07A'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#FFCE1F'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#EFA900'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='beakGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FF9A3C'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E86A12'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- water ripple -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='40' ry='7' fill='#2E6FD6'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='34' ry='5' fill='#4C93F0'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='20' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M20 56 Q10 50 16 44 Q22 48 27 52 Z' fill='#F5B700'/>

  <!-- wing -->
  <path d='M44 58 Q36 60 38 68 Q46 68 52 64 Z' fill='#E8A200'/>

  <!-- neck/head -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='34' r='17' fill='url(#headGrad)'/>

  <!-- cheek shine -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='30' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#FFF6A8' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='67' cy='30' r='3.6' fill='#1F3A8A'/>
  <circle cx='68.2' cy='28.8' r='1.3' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M76 33 Q94 32 92 39 Q90 44 78 42 Z' fill='url(#beakGrad)'/>
  <path d='M78 37 Q90 38 90 40 Q86 41 78 40 Z' fill='#C4530A' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
